relevance_note: Case report of a girl with HA20 due to a novel heterozygous TNFAIP3 variant ('a heterozygous mutation (c.436_437deTC) in the TNFAIP3 gene'), whose Table 1 also summarises this patient and 29 previously reported TNFAIP3 patients.
method_note: Read only the paper Markdown, the schema and the rules; no script transcribed anything, every cell was typed by hand from the converted text and Table 1. Table 1 columns, named once here: Pedigree | Mutation location | Onset age | Sex | Clinical manifestation | Other medical history | Diagnosis | References. Onset-age and sex spans quote the table row from its start through that cell, diagnosis and label spans quote the row through the Diagnosis cell, and each patient's whole Clinical manifestation cell is recorded as one phenotypic_features row because that cell lists several features inside one string. Inconsistencies found in the paper: the variant is printed three ways ('c.436-437deTC' in the abstract, 'c.436_437deTC' in the text and Table 1, 'c.436_437delTC' in the Figure 4 legend); the Introduction says 'a total of 30 cases, including this case', the Discussion says 'the 48 cases reported so far' and the abstract says 61 cases worldwide, so cohort_size_as_stated uses 30 and n_patients_reported uses 1; for the case-report patient Table 1 gives 'nonspecific rash', 'genital ulcers' and 'synovitis of right knee' while the text reports 'no skin rash', the parents' denial of 'vulvar ulcer' and of 'joint pain', so that patient's checklist items 'skin lesions (rash, folliculitis, erythema nodosum)', 'genital ulcers' and 'arthritis or arthralgia' are left 'not reported' and both readings appear as phenotypic_features rows. Labels: rows after the first row of a family have an empty Pedigree cell, so I used '<family> patient <k>' in table order; the case-report patient is labelled 'This case' (its own Pedigree cell) and her parents 'father of This case'/'mother of This case' (relations as written). The References cell is printed only on the first row of a family, so I copied the family reference to all members of that family (D-23) and used 'not reported' where no reference is printed (Families 3-11). Family 1's Mutation location cell says only 'TNFAIP3', so its four patients have variant_original_string 'not reported'. Family 3 patients 3 and 4 are printed as identical rows, so their spans are identical text. Checklist mapping decisions: 'Fever' taken as recurrent fever; 'stomatitis' as oral ulcers; 'intestinal ulcers' as gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation; 'Presence of gastrointestinal symptoms' recorded as a feature but not mapped to gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation; 'aquatic keratoderma', 'severe inflammatory swelling of skin after vaccination', plain 'acne' and 'skin abscess' were not mapped to skin lesions, while rashes, folliculitis, eczema, pityriasis rosea, pseudofolliculitis and urticaria were; iron deficiency anemia recorded as a feature but not as cytopenia (autoimmune); pulmonary granuloma recorded as a feature but not as interstitial lung disease; 'pericardial effusion' mapped to pericarditis or other serositis; 'Cerebral palsy' and 'encephalopathy' mapped to central nervous system involvement; 'synovitis of right knee', 'joint pain' and 'arthralgia' mapped to arthritis or arthralgia; 'pulmonary embolism' and 'thrombophlebitis' were not mapped to vasculitis. Normal findings recorded as excluded for the case patient: 'no skin rash', 'no conjunctival congestion', the parents' denial of 'photophobia, tears, blurred vision, joint pain, and vulvar ulcer', 'The shifting dullness was negative.', and 'There was no tenderness and muscle tension.'; 'No abnormalities in the heart and lungs were found.' and 'No abnormalities were noted in the vulva and perianal areas.' were not used, because they name no specific abnormality, and 'The neurological examination was negative.' was not used to exclude any checklist item. The case patient's normal height of 88 cm was not treated as excluding growth failure. No cell in Table 1 holds values stacked with ' / '; empty cells, '\' and '/' were treated as not reported. Variant fields (variant type, zygosity, inheritance, pathogenicity, ACMG criteria, functional evidence) are 'not reported' for Table 1 patients because the table states no class for them, except 'Heterozygosity' for Family 5, recorded as zygosity heterozygous.
